title: Lirik Lagu My Love Oscar Harris
body:
PULNEW.COM - Berikut lirik lagu 'You Are My Love' dari Oscar Harris yang berhasil ditranskrip dari audio.

[music] My love Till you came into my life one day Till you came into my life one day My love It gave me more than ever I can say [music] Then I felt something went wrong Oh, how I needed you when you went away Good times that we used to have are just three Oh, today I couldn't see how we tried to forget me I couldn't feel you would try to leave me And all too sweet won't please leave Please don't try to leave behind a smiling face Try to love and try to live in my sweet embrace [music] [music] My love You know your heart can't believe with you My love Something that you're gonna make me blue Oh, there's no more goodbye Oh, how it has to be so too late to let you go For a while, I keep up the better then Maybe I'll sign up I could see how you tried to forget me I could feel you would try to leave me And all too sweet won't please leave Please don't try to leave behind a smiling face Try to love and try to live in my sweet embrace Oh, how it has to be so too late to let you go [music]
